notes.title: Let the battle begin: Battle tutorial of My Little Miniatures
notes.content:
My Little Miniatures is out now, and you can acquire it in the shop anytime, welcome to join the epic battle! Now follow the tutorial below and learn how to battle against the enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161207/55cc427b3488c744459f341cf6b27bc369938188.png[/img]

[b]Summon the miniatures[/b]
At the beginning, you need to summon the miniatures. Different miniatures will come up on the preparing zone, waiting for you to pick. Choose the one you need by dragging it down to the site, and it will fight for you in the future battle. Miniatures could be enhanced in the right way.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161207/95430f8e9c81a4233f99f55167d64ac9b14e1e4a.gif[/img]

[b]Choose the right skill[/b]
Miniatures have various kinds of talent besides normal hit. For example, if you summon miniatures "Big Shot" you will automatically gain 1 extra gold, which might help you in some circumstances. Amazing effects could be achieved by choosing different skills. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43161207/881c67eb17ed138752eb214639dc2b71d9bfcb0e.png[/img]

[b]About this game[/b]
My Little Miniatures is a strategy game combining entertaining auto-battler gameplay with competitive tactics. Fighting in battles, ration your golds and items sensibly, ponder on the features of various formations, activate powerful synergies with unique builds!

We are thrilled to say that My Little Miniatures is now officially release! Since the game is still being polished, we would like to hear any kind of comments, suggestions, or criticism, if you have any please let us know, thank you!
